summary_1line: Rama returns to an empty hermitage, laments Sita’s disappearance in anguish, and with Lakshmana searches the forest unsuccessfully.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands before the deserted forest hut with arms raised in despair, the grassy seats scattered and no sign of Sita.
Overwhelmed by grief, Rama collapses in the forest calling out 'O Sita, my beloved!' while Lakshmana stands before him with folded hands trying to console him.
Rama and Lakshmana wander through dense woods and rocky caves searching desperately for Sita among rivers, hills, and lotus-covered lakes.
